title: Event Rules – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: Bibs are personal identifiers and may not be exchanged, transferred or sold; entry fees and ancillary purchases are non-refundable and non-transferable, though an optional service fee buys a 100% refund for listed reasons; participants who cancel keep access to a guaranteed entry for the next event.

A participant who receives any assistance from another person may be disqualified; assistance includes conveying advice, information or direct/indirect help by any means including technical communication devices, and pacing by persons not officially participating. Officially designated Guide Runners, Support Runners and contracted pacesetters who start in the Event are excepted.

No person without an official bib may be on the course, and no participant may receive assistance or refreshment from anyone without event management permission; a participant who leaves the course may not rejoin to gain a place or to pace or assist another runner.

Music devices are permitted except for athletes competing for overall awards or prize money; headphones are not permitted for High Performance Program athletes. Selfie-sticks, camera mounts, video devices, computers and drones are prohibited; wheeled devices are limited to registered wheelchair/handcycle/duo participants and authorized bicycle marshals; hydration backpacks are prohibited, while fuel belts, handheld bottles and soft flasks are allowed.

The course time limit is 6:30 and the lead vehicle maintains a 15-minute-per-mile pace; runners outside the limit may not be recorded or published as official finishers. Professional divisions are ranked on gun time; all other participants are ranked on net time; appeals must be submitted within 14 days of event day.
Packets must be collected in person at the Abbott Health & Fitness Expo against photo identification; packets are not available on race day and are not mailed.
